_comment: Which authored VRCAM component the mod should switch on. Written by the launcher when the
user picks a render resolution; read by the native plugin (view identity) and by
modules/vrcam_select.lua (enables that one component, disables the rest).
'component' is the only required field. 'virtualCamera' is optional: when absent it is
derived by replacing the 'vrcam_' prefix with 'vrcam_feed_'.
The value must name a component that exists on the player entity. An unknown name leaves
every component disabled (no VRCAM view) and is logged, rather than silently falling back.
PREREQUISITE: the player entity must carry the component set produced by
tools/gen_vrcam_assets.py and imported through WolvenKit. Listing a name here does not
create it. Deleting this file makes the plugin fall back to the legacy 'vrcam' /
_components_comment: Every VRCAM component that exists on the player entity. The launcher offers exactly this
list and nothing else, so a name here without an imported component would select a view
that cannot render. Names must carry the <W>x<H> suffix; that is where the launcher reads
Generated by tools/gen_vrcam_assets.py from the ladders in launcher_dialog.cpp -- edit the
ladders and re-run rather than editing this array, or the two drift apart again.
